# Multi-Cloud Reference Architecture & Workload Placement Strategy

This document provides a detailed design for the 'Multi-Cloud Reference Architecture & Workload Placement Strategy', a critical component of our broader 'Multi-Cloud Strategy & Execution Assessment'. The primary goal is to validate the proposed federated multi-cloud strategy, ensuring it effectively addresses specialized AI/ML and data-intensive workload requirements. Success means stakeholders understand and endorse the architectural approach for extending Azure with alternate hyperscalers while maintaining robust governance. This strategy is designed to overcome the limitations of a single-hyperscaler approach for advanced use cases, leveraging the strengths of multiple cloud providers.
